1 on days a site-wide online discount or promo code was live; 0 = full-price day.
Daily net online revenue (site + app) after discounts and returns, excluding shipping and sales tax.
Portion of Total_Revenue from customers placing their first-ever order with the brand.
Fees paid for sponsored creator content, booked on the day the content went live. Zero on most days.
Commission and network fees paid to the Awin affiliate network (cashback, coupon and content publishers).

Google Performance Max campaigns (automated across Search, Shopping, YouTube, Display, Discover, Gmail, Maps).
Google Demand Gen campaigns (YouTube, Discover and Gmail feeds).

Meta campaigns targeting site visitors, cart abandoners and CRM segments.

Total Meta Ads spend as reported by the platform: the sum of the three spend_Meta_* lines (small rounding differences vs the components are as reported). Do not add to the components.
